beats.say: Hit musical series Glee is officially returning with a brand new reboot.
The original show ran for six seasons on Fox, co created by Ryan Murphy, Ian Brennan and Brad Falchuk.
During its run, the musical phenomenon picked up six Emmys.
Even today, songs from the series draw about 4 million monthly listeners on Spotify.
Now, Disney+ and Hulu have officially greenlit the reboot, with 20th Television producing.
Will you be watching the new Glee reboot?
